issue.title: ROASフィルター削除・CVRの日本語表記修正

summary: Remove the ROAS filter and standardize customer-facing CVR terminology in Japanese without changing metric formulas.
decisions: Remove ROAS only as a filter; do not silently remove valid ROAS KPI display or calculation unless separately specified.
Use one approved Japanese CVR label and help text across customer-facing surfaces.
Metric semantics and missing-value behavior remain unchanged.
requirementRefs: DESIGN.md#6-表示とアクセシビリティ

risks.description: A copy/filter change may accidentally alter KPI calculation or hide ROAS entirely.
risks.mitigation: Keep calculation contracts untouched and assert KPI payloads before/after.

risks.description: Old ROAS filter query state may continue affecting results.
risks.mitigation: Ignore/remove the deprecated filter and cover old bookmarked URLs.

acceptanceCriteria: No interactive ROAS filter remains in the product or active URL state.
Existing ROAS KPI data, where required, is not removed by this issue.
CVR label and explanatory copy are consistent in Japanese.
Missing CVR remains '-' and is not presented as zero.
Old URLs containing the deprecated filter do not break the screen or alter results.

rollback.strategy: Revert copy/query cleanup without changing metric storage or formulas.
rollback.verification: Metric payload contract and missing-value display remain unchanged.
